name: Judas
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament

points: The lists differ across the gospels. Simon is also called Peter and Cephas. Simon the Canaanite is the same as Simon Zelotes. Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus, is the same as Judas the brother of James, who is also called Jude.
Judas the brother of James is not Judas Iscariot the traitor. He called himself Jude or Thaddaeus so as not to be associated with the traitor.
